title: preCICE tutorials: metadata.yaml
description: Metadata of a tutorial: its participants and the cases (directories) that can play the role of each participant.

path.description: Directory of the tutorial, relative to the root of the repository.

url.description: URL of the documentation page of the tutorial.

participants.description: The participants of the coupled simulation.

cases.description: The available cases, by name. Each case provides one participant.

participant.description: The participant that this case provides. Must be one of the listed participants.

directory.description: Directory of the case, relative to the tutorial directory.

run.description: Command to run the case, executed in its directory. Leave empty (null) for cases that do not run anything, e.g., a placeholder for a participant that is not needed.

component.description: The component (as defined in tests/components.yaml) that this case needs.
